# SvgRasterizer

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a self-contained SVG document to PNG bytes, at the pixel size its `width` and `height` attributes give.

Supplied by the caller: this package never rasterizes anything itself, which is what keeps it free of dependencies. Any renderer will do - a headless browser, resvg, a server. It is called once per distinct snippet, in document order.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type SvgRasterizer = (svg: string) => Promise<Uint8Array>
```
